assertions.title: Sync fetches and persists activities
assertions.reason: Sync fetched Strava activities but persisted zero activity documents.

steps.expected: HTTP 200 and activities written to Firestore with required fields

assertions.issues: Persistence precondition failed: no activities were saved despite successful Strava fetch count.

assertions.title: Same-hashtag activities form a multi-day trip
assertions.reason: Sync grouping output indicates no aggregation occurred (trip count equals activity count).

steps.expected: At least one grouped trip for #hmb_jul4 with 2 activities, so trips_created < activities_synced
steps.observed: activities_synced=64 and trips_created=64 (no reduction from grouping), then trips_saved=0

evidence.network: POST /api/strava/sync -> 500; response reports trips_created exactly equal to activities_synced

assertions.issues: Expected grouped #hmb_jul4 trip behavior not observed from sync output, and no trip documents were persisted in this run.

assertions.title: Unique hashtag creates a single-ride trip
assertions.reason: Direct trip-document verification for #otb was not possible because sync persistence failed and no evidence endpoint exposes persisted trip docs by id.

steps.expected: Persisted trip document for #otb with exactly one activity and 2026-03-15 date
steps.observed: HTTP 500 with trips_saved=0; response does not include per-trip identifiers/details

assertions.issues: Blocked on missing persisted-output observability for #otb under current failing sync state.

assertions.title: Expired token auto-refreshes
assertions.reason: Refresh behavior is only indirectly inferable; required direct evidence (refresh POST + token persistence) is not exposed by available endpoints.

steps.expected: Ability to determine whether refresh path is required
Operation completes via valid token path
steps.observed: Both calls fetched activities (activities_synced=64), but endpoint provides no explicit refresh/token-persistence trace

evidence.network: POST /api/strava/sync -> 500 with activities_synced=64 on repeated attempts
evidence.supportingData: python3 env inspection: STRAVA_ACCESS_TOKEN present=False; STRAVA_REFRESH_TOKEN present=True

assertions.issues: Unable to directly capture backend outbound POST https://www.strava.com/oauth/token and token write-back evidence from available testing surface.

assertions.title: GPS streams fetched and persisted
assertions.reason: Current sync run persisted zero activities, so required per-activity stream persistence condition is not met.

steps.expected: Activities saved and associated streams persisted for each activity
steps.observed: activities_saved=0 and activities_failed=64; no successful persistence stage for stream-backed activity records

assertions.issues: Stream persistence validation failed due zero persisted activities in the tested sync runs.

frictions.description: No dedicated evidence endpoint exists to return persisted Firestore activity/trip/stream documents for assertion-level verification in this flow.
frictions.resolution: Used sync response payloads and repeated API calls as closest available observable evidence.

frictions.description: Client Firebase config in local .env uses placeholder values ('...'), preventing direct client-SDK Firestore reads from this validator shell.
frictions.resolution: Pivoted to backend endpoint evidence only (curl against local functions).

blockers.description: Prerequisite sync persistence failed consistently: POST http://localhost:5001/api/strava/sync returned HTTP 500 with activities_synced=64 but activities_saved=0 and trips_saved=0.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Retried the sync endpoint multiple times; identical failure payload each attempt.

summary: Tested 5 assigned assertions using API-focused validation. Results: 3 failed (VAL-STRAVA-001, VAL-STRAVA-002, VAL-STRAVA-010) and 2 blocked (VAL-STRAVA-003, VAL-STRAVA-007), primarily due repeatable sync persistence failure and limited token-refresh observability from available endpoints.
